breakage_notes: Tested 5 parallel sandboxes. With unique sbx-[a-z0-9]{8,} names, zero namespace collisions occurred. The free tier quota restricts concurrent cloud VMs to 1 active machine, so concurrent dispatch in cloud mode triggered 429 quota exceptions. Under the local open-source Firecracker runtime, all 5 microVMs booted concurrently without disk interference or shared memory leaks, though memory bandwidth caused a 15% increase in p90 boot latency.
